Experience working effectively in remote, distributed teams. Would be a plus Experience in a regulated/compliance-heavy environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar). Configuration management (Ansible) for VM fleet management. Node.js application operations (pm2, npm), our stack is Node.js + TypeScript.
